t: 波斯大帝赛勒斯的军队征服了巴比伦,结束了新巴比罗尼亚帝国. (儒略历)
te: The army of Cyrus the Great of Persia conquer Babylon, ending the Neo-Babylonian Empire. (Julian calendar)
